name: tavily_search
description: Web search via Tavily API. Returns ranked search results with title, URL, content snippet, and optional AI-generated answer. Use this for: current events, documentation lookup, news, prices, or any info that needs a fresh web search. Supports search_depth='basic' (fast) or 'advanced' (slower but more thorough, includes answer). Requires TAVILY_API_KEY.

query.description: Search query. Be specific: include year, version, exact terms. e.g. 'Rust 1.81 async fn in traits 2024' instead of 'Rust async'.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return. Default 5, max 20.

search_depth.description: Search depth: 'basic' (fast, 1 credit per request) or 'advanced' (slower, 2 credits, includes AI answer).

topic.description: Topic category for filtering. Default 'general'. Use 'news' for current events.

_comment_env: ADR-0023 P3-C: 用 keychain: 引用避免明文存盘. value 以 'keychain:' 开头 → 从 OS keychain (service='pi-agent', user=冒号后那段) 取明文; 其他字符串 → 跟以前一样当字面 env 值. 推荐命名 'external-<tool>-<field>' 跟 keychain index 命名空间一致.
